principles: Intuition is a hypothesis generator, never the independent probability model.
Describe competing pathways and link each to player opportunity, efficiency, and ticket outcome.
Keep role and injury uncertainty explicit, avoid anchoring to unverified prices.
Always record anti-thesis and what pregame / in-game observable would falsify the script.
Do not add independent marginal hit rates for correlated tickets; use P11/P10/P01/P00 when defensible.

scripts.name: Detroit controls paint/boards; Boston creates perimeter looks
causal_chain: Duren/Ausar rebound opportunities depend on Boston miss count and their own minutes
Boston shooters may generate 3PA, but steals and transition possessions can shorten halfcourt
Cade assist upside depends on teammate made shots, not just passes
scripts.counter_case: Boston efficiency reduces rebound chances; role/minutes uncertain

scripts.name: Boston switch/pressure stalls Cade and shrinks Detroit possessions
causal_chain: Cade on-ball pressure alters scoring vs playmaking split
Ausar deflections and transition opportunities depend on opponent possession rate
Detroit 3PM can fail even if Cade produces potential assists
scripts.counter_case: Detroit off-ball spacing beats switches; foul game yields more total possessions

scripts.name: Boston offense redistributes shots among returners and newcomers
causal_chain: White/Pritchard role sharing depends on Tatum and George usage
Robinson and Queta compete for big-man minutes
White made threes and Pritchard assists may split rather than rise together
scripts.counter_case: Starting combinations, injuries and new coach utilization unknown

monitor: confirmed starters and bench center split

scripts.name: Philadelphia's multiple creators trade scoring for facilitation
causal_chain: LeBron/Maxey/Brown/Embiid share possessions; usage sum constrained
Maxey off-ball spot-up threes could grow while self-created points contract
Knicks perimeter defenders might shift assignments midgame
candidates: Jaylen Brown points under as conditional research
scripts.counter_case: Philadelphia staggers stars and preserves high primary usage

scripts.name: Knicks win rebounding battle but lose pace
causal_chain: Towns and Hart benefit only if there are misses to capture
Embiid availability alters shot and rebound distribution
Slow pace can suppress Brunson counting stats even in a close game
scripts.counter_case: Fast-paced game with higher FGA offsets better opponent shooting

scripts.name: High-scoring shot-making war
causal_chain: Made shots improve assist settlements but reduce defensive rebound totals
Three-point attempts favor shot volume markets if player minutes hold
Two star overs may be coherent yet badly priced and lack +EV
candidates: Towns rebounds under only if line+pricing support
scripts.counter_case: defensive scheme and short rotations suppress pace

monitor: shot attempts, potential assists, rebound chances

scripts.name: Wembanyama controls paint; Thunder take pull-up/three-heavy offense
causal_chain: Wemby block events may decline if fewer attacks reach him even if he plays superb defense
Chet/Hartenstein rebound opportunity shifts with Spurs shot volume and paint deterrence
Wemby PRA over 42.5 requires enough points+rebounds+assists; excellent impact need not imply PRA over
scripts.counter_case: OKC aggressively attacks rim anyway; foul risk changes Wemby minutes

scripts.name: SGA pace and free throws dictate game
causal_chain: Repeated SGA drives create both scoring and Wemby rim-defense opportunities
Thunder live-ball steals may cut Spurs possessions and creation upside
Wallace steals could coincide with low Spurs PRA outcomes; correlation can be negative
scripts.counter_case: Spurs perimeter containment forces SGA assists and limits FTs

scripts.name: Spurs guards redistribute creation; Wemby benefits as finisher
causal_chain: Fox/Castle/Harper cannot each maintain maximal touches at once
Castle and Harper assist upside depends on Wemby conversion and lineup overlap
Early rotation substitution pattern is critical
scripts.counter_case: Staggered point guard rotations let individual role exceed shared-floor assumptions

scripts.name: Blowout / foul-trouble stress path
causal_chain: Stars can outperform per-minute and still miss counting thresholds on reduced minutes
Bench scoring may rise while starting center rebound/assist opportunities fall
A double-double or 42.5 PRA depends on settlement, not subjective quality of play
scripts.counter_case: Late comeback preserves full fourth-quarter minutes

monitor: verified starter lineup and injury list
OKC rim attempts and three-point share
SGA free throw attempts and assists

examples.mechanism: SGA rim attacks can create block chances, but defensive stops can suppress scoring.
Boston missed threes can boost Duren boards while made threes support White's leg.
Castle-to-Wemby scoring can raise assists and points, but guard role distribution and Wemby rebounds/assists may diverge.

acceptance: A falsifiable pregame script map, not an approved betslip or proof of predictive performance
